tasks.title: Canyon Strike
tasks.summary: Fly an authored canyon mission, destroy five air and ground targets, then extract.
tasks.summaryZh: 驾驶战机完成峡谷任务，摧毁五个空地目标后穿过撤离门。

evaluation.objective: Destroy three ground emplacements and two interceptors, then cross extraction before time or health runs out.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 摧毁三座地面阵地和两架截击机，并在时间或生命耗尽前完成撤离。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone controls must support full flight, cannon fire, missile lock, launch, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都必须支持完整飞行、机炮、导弹锁定、发射与重新开始。

checklist.text: Flight, terrain collision, weapons, enemies, timer, and extraction form one causal mission.
checklist.textZh: 飞行、地形碰撞、武器、敌人、计时与撤离组成有因果关系的完整任务。

checklist.text: Targets and route cues stay readable at both required viewports.
checklist.textZh: 目标与航线提示在两个规定视口都清晰可读。

checklist.text: Victory requires all five targets and a real extraction crossing.
checklist.textZh: 胜利必须同时满足摧毁五个目标与实际穿过撤离门。

tasks.title: Bombsite Retake
tasks.summary: Retake a compact tactical site through one of two routes, defeat both defenders, and defuse.
tasks.summaryZh: 从两条路线之一反攻紧凑战术区域，击败两名防守者并完成拆除。

evaluation.objective: Eliminate both defenders and complete the hold-to-defuse interaction before the planted device expires.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 在装置倒计时结束前消灭两名防守者，并完成持续交互拆除。
evaluation.controls: Desktop pointer-lock and phone twin-stick play must expose fire, reload, crouch, interact, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面指针锁定与手机双摇杆操作都要提供射击、换弹、蹲伏、交互和重新开始。

checklist.text: Two topologically separate approaches create different cover and exposure decisions.
checklist.textZh: 两条拓扑独立的进攻路线形成不同的掩体与暴露选择。

checklist.text: Bots use readable line-of-sight combat without shooting through cover.
checklist.textZh: 机器人依据清晰的视线规则战斗，不能穿透掩体射击。

checklist.text: Neither kills alone nor an early defuse can trigger victory.
checklist.textZh: 仅击杀敌人或提前拆除都不能单独触发胜利。

tasks.title: First Night
tasks.summary: Gather voxel resources, craft exact recipes, build a real shelter, place a beacon, and survive until dawn.
tasks.summaryZh: 采集体素资源，按精确配方制作物品，建成真实庇护所、放置信标并生存到黎明。

evaluation.objective: Complete gathering, crafting, spatial shelter construction, beacon placement, night defense, and dawn survival.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 完成采集、制作、空间庇护所建造、信标放置、夜间防守与黎明生存。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone play must support movement, look, mining, placement, inventory, crafting, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都要支持移动、观察、挖掘、放置、背包、制作与重新开始。

checklist.text: World editing, inventory, and exact recipes are functional rather than decorative.
checklist.textZh: 世界编辑、背包与精确配方必须真正可用，而非装饰。

checklist.text: Shelter validity requires enclosed standable interior space and a roof.
checklist.textZh: 有效庇护所必须具有封闭、可站立的内部空间和屋顶。

checklist.text: Victory requires a placed beacon, valid shelter, and actual dawn.
checklist.textZh: 胜利必须同时满足已放置信标、庇护所有效和实际到达黎明。

tasks.title: Village Quest
tasks.summary: Accept a quest, fight two enemy roles, use a meaningful defensive ability, loot a relic, and turn it in.
tasks.summaryZh: 接取任务，对抗两类敌人并有效使用防御技能，拾取遗物后返回交付。

evaluation.objective: Complete the full accept, travel, combat, loot, return, and explicit turn-in chain.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 完成接取、旅行、战斗、拾取、返回与明确交付的完整任务链。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone controls must support movement, camera, targeting, interaction, attacks, abilities, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都要支持移动、镜头、选敌、交互、攻击、技能与重新开始。

checklist.text: Village, route, and ruin are distinct readable places tied to quest stages.
checklist.textZh: 村庄、路线与遗迹是与任务阶段相连的清晰不同场所。

checklist.text: At least two enemy roles and a telegraphed threat create a real defensive decision.
checklist.textZh: 至少两类敌人与一次可预判威胁形成真实的防御决策。

checklist.text: The relic cannot appear early and victory requires returning to the quest giver.
checklist.textZh: 遗物不能提前出现，胜利必须返回任务发布者处交付。

tasks.title: Ashen Duel
tasks.summary: Fight a readable two-phase guardian using stamina, committed attacks, dodges, and limited healing.
tasks.summaryZh: 运用耐力、不可随意取消的攻击、闪避和有限治疗，对抗可读的双阶段守卫。

evaluation.objective: Learn and defeat a two-phase boss with at least four telegraphed attacks while managing stamina and healing.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 管理耐力与治疗，读懂并击败拥有至少四种预兆攻击的双阶段首领。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone controls must support movement, camera, lock-on, light and heavy attacks, dodge, heal, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都要支持移动、镜头、锁定、轻重攻击、闪避、治疗与重新开始。

checklist.text: Telegraph, active, and recovery windows create learnable punish opportunities.
checklist.textZh: 预兆、生效与恢复阶段形成可学习的反击窗口。

checklist.text: Stamina, commitment, dodge invulnerability, and punishable healing all matter.
checklist.textZh: 耐力、动作承诺、闪避无敌帧与可被惩罚的治疗都具有实际意义。

checklist.text: The second phase changes behavior, not only color.
checklist.textZh: 第二阶段必须改变行为，而不只是换色。

tasks.title: Linked Chamber
tasks.summary: Place two linked portals, traverse them with the player and cube, power a door, and escape.
tasks.summaryZh: 放置一对联结传送门，让玩家和方块都穿越，压住开关并逃离密室。

evaluation.objective: Use camera-correct paired portals and a portal-traversing cube to hold the switch and reach the exit.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 利用视角正确的成对传送门，让方块穿越并压住开关后到达出口。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone controls must support movement, look, jump, interaction, both portal colors, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都要支持移动、观察、跳跃、交互、两种传送门与重新开始。

checklist.text: Portal views update from the paired camera and are not static colored surfaces.
checklist.textZh: 传送门画面由配对相机实时更新，不能只是静态色块。

checklist.text: Player and cube traversal preserve sensible orientation and avoid re-entry loops.
checklist.textZh: 玩家与方块穿越后方向合理，并避免反复传送。

checklist.text: The only solution requires the cube to traverse a portal and hold the switch.
checklist.textZh: 唯一解法必须让方块穿越传送门并压住开关。

tasks.title: Star Course
tasks.summary: Cross a three-part platform course, defeat an enemy, transfer between moving platforms, and earn the goal star.
tasks.summaryZh: 穿越三段平台关卡，击败敌人、完成移动平台换乘并取得目标之星。

evaluation.objective: Collect eight coins, complete a skill defeat and moving-platform transfer, then reach and collect the unlocked star.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 收集八枚金币，完成技巧击败和移动平台换乘，再到达并取得已解锁的星星。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone controls must support nuanced movement, camera, jump timing, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都要支持细腻移动、镜头、跳跃时机与重新开始。

checklist.text: Movement, camera, coyote timing, landing, and checkpoints support reliable platforming.
checklist.textZh: 移动、镜头、土狼时间、落地与检查点共同支持可靠的平台跳跃。

checklist.text: A real transfer between moving platforms is unavoidable on the summit route.
checklist.textZh: 通往山顶的路线必须经过一次真实的移动平台换乘。

checklist.text: The star cannot unlock without eight coins and one skill-based enemy defeat.
checklist.textZh: 未收集八枚金币且未完成一次技巧击败时，星星不能解锁。

tasks.title: Turbo Circuit
tasks.summary: Race three rivals for three laps using earned drift boosts, two item types, and alternate lines.
tasks.summaryZh: 利用漂移加速、两类道具与替代路线，与三名对手完成三圈竞速。

evaluation.objective: Win a validated three-lap race after earning a drift boost and using both boost and slow-field items.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 完成有效三圈并取得第一名，过程中赚取漂移加速且使用加速和减速场两类道具。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone controls must support steering, acceleration, brake, drift, item use, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都要支持转向、加速、刹车、漂移、使用道具与重新开始。

checklist.text: Ordered checkpoints, wrong-way handling, recovery, and AI use the same legal course.
checklist.textZh: 顺序检查点、逆行处理、脱困与 AI 都遵守同一条合法赛道。

checklist.text: Drift changes handling and awards a duration-scaled boost rather than a free speed button.
checklist.textZh: 漂移必须改变操控并按持续时间给予加速，不能只是免费加速按钮。

checklist.text: Idle or no-drift play loses to at least one rival, and both item types matter in a winning run.
checklist.textZh: 闲置或不漂移时至少输给一名对手，获胜过程中两类道具都必须有实际作用。

tasks.title: Frontier Command
tasks.summary: Gather resources, build a barracks, train an army, survive a raid, and destroy the enemy keep.
tasks.summaryZh: 采集资源、建造兵营、训练军队、抵御突袭并摧毁敌方要塞。

evaluation.objective: Execute a complete economy-to-assault loop, including production and a resolved enemy raid.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 完成从经济到进攻的完整循环，包括生产与一次已解决的敌方突袭。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone controls must support camera, selection, commands, gathering, building, production, combat, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都要支持镜头、选择、命令、采集、建造、生产、战斗与重新开始。

checklist.text: Workers gather and return finite loads; buildings and units consume real resources and time.
checklist.textZh: 工人采集并送回有限载荷，建筑和单位真实消耗资源与时间。

checklist.text: Selection, navigation, combat, raid defense, and production remain readable and controllable.
checklist.textZh: 选择、导航、战斗、守卫突袭与生产过程清晰且可控制。

checklist.text: Victory requires a barracks, at least three trained soldiers, a resolved raid, and a destroyed enemy keep.
checklist.textZh: 胜利必须具备兵营、至少三名已训练士兵、已解决的突袭和被摧毁的敌方要塞。

tasks.title: Dinner Rush
tasks.summary: Coordinate two chefs across preparation, cooking, plating, service, mistakes, and washing.
tasks.summaryZh: 协调两名厨师完成备料、烹饪、装盘、上菜、错误处理与清洗。

evaluation.objective: Prepare and deliver five valid dishes from three recipes before the four-minute service ends.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 在四分钟营业结束前，按三种配方制作并交付五份有效菜品。
evaluation.controls: Desktop and phone controls must support movement, chef switching, pickup/place, station actions, and restart.
evaluation.controlsZh: 桌面端和手机端都要支持移动、切换厨师、拿取/放置、工作站操作与重新开始。

checklist.text: All three recipes validate ingredients and preparation state rather than accepting arbitrary objects.
checklist.textZh: 三种配方都要校验食材与加工状态，不能接受任意物体。

checklist.text: Cooking, burning, disposal, dirty plates, and washing create recoverable coordination pressure.
checklist.textZh: 烹饪、烧焦、丢弃、脏盘与清洗形成可恢复的协作压力。

checklist.text: Five accepted deliveries win; timeout with fewer deliveries loses and restarts cleanly.
checklist.textZh: 五份有效交付获胜；不足五份时超时失败，并可干净地重新开始。
